known_gaps: Conformal intervals are calibrated exclusively against synthetic intradocument shuffle perturbations. They provide distribution-free guarantees on shuffle detection error, but must not be misinterpreted as calibrated against real-world human legal dispute annotations.
Interval sharpness is wide (mean width 0.9933) reflecting conservative finite-sample bounds on anomaly residuals.
Calibration metadata 'synthetic_shuffle_only' must continue to be visibly propagated to UI/API layers in subsequent prompts.
